boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Hampden-Sydney practices, symbols, ceremonies, and recurring campus rituals.

cards.title: Sign the Honor Pledge
cards.subtitle: New-student matriculation tradition
cards.notes: At matriculation, look for the Honor Pledge signing ceremony; the College identifies it as a solemn freshman tradition and visual marker of entry.
cards.short_summary: New students formally join the campus honor tradition by signing the pledge.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says each freshman signs the Honor Code as a sacred and solemn pledge.
cards.access_notes: Participation is part of new-student matriculation; observe College event guidance.

cards.title: A Greeting Is Expected
cards.subtitle: Sidewalk and campus-wide courtesy practice
cards.notes: When moving through campus, return greetings courteously. The student handbook calls greeting people a long-standing, revered sign of brotherhood and respect.
cards.short_summary: A daily greeting custom turns ordinary walks across campus into a recognized practice.
cards.evidence_claim: The current student handbook calls greeting all persons on campus one of the College's longest-standing and most revered practices.
cards.source_title: The Key: The Hampden-Sydney College Student Handbook, 2025–2026
cards.access_notes: Use ordinary courtesy and respect personal space; no special access is needed.

cards.title: Listen for the Hand-Rung Bell
cards.subtitle: Watkins Bell Tower
cards.notes: Pause near the tower during the academic day to hear the bell that still signals classes; do not enter restricted areas or handle its rope.
cards.short_summary: The campus preserves a manually rung bell as part of the daily rhythm of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's historical project says it still employs someone to ring the bell rather than automate it.
cards.access_notes: View from public campus paths; bell operation is performed by College staff.

cards.entity_name: Huc Venite Iuvenes ut Exeatis Viri
cards.title: Read the Gate Motto
cards.subtitle: College gates
cards.notes: Read the Latin inscription at the gates and its official translation. Treat the gates as a campus landmark rather than climbing or altering them.
cards.short_summary: The gate inscription frames the College's passage from youth to adulthood.
cards.evidence_claim: The handbook identifies the gate motto as “Come here as youths so that you may leave as men.”
cards.source_title: The Key: The Hampden-Sydney College Student Handbook, 2025–2026
cards.access_notes: Accessible as part of a normal campus visit; follow visitor and event guidance.

cards.title: Wear Garnet and Gray
cards.subtitle: College colors
cards.notes: Use garnet and gray for a game, ceremony, or campus event. The College traces the colors to its early history and later athletic adoption.
cards.short_summary: The College's two colors carry an official historical story tied to its earliest students.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says garnet and gray were adopted as College colors when sports teams were introduced in the 19th century.
cards.access_notes: No purchase is implied; wear existing clothing or simply notice the colors at events.

cards.title: Learn the Hampden-Sydney Hymn
cards.subtitle: Official College song
cards.notes: Read or sing along with the College hymn at an appropriate gathering. Use the current handbook's printed version rather than relying on unofficial lyrics.
cards.short_summary: The handbook preserves a named alma-mater hymn in its College songs section.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025–2026 student handbook includes “The Hampden-Sydney Hymn” among the College songs.
cards.source_title: The Key: The Hampden-Sydney College Student Handbook, 2025–2026
cards.access_notes: Follow the host event's participation expectations.

cards.title: Recognize “Glass of the Finest”
cards.subtitle: Official College song
cards.notes: Treat this as a documented College song rather than a drinking prompt. Learn its refrain from the handbook and follow alcohol rules at every event.
cards.short_summary: A second named College song is printed alongside the alma-mater hymn.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025–2026 student handbook lists “Glass of the Finest” in its College songs section.
cards.source_title: The Key: The Hampden-Sydney College Student Handbook, 2025–2026
cards.access_notes: The card concerns the song only; do not use it to encourage alcohol consumption.

cards.title: Take the Rhetoric Proficiency Examination
cards.subtitle: Required College-wide writing milestone
cards.notes: Plan ahead for the timed writing exam after completing the relevant coursework. It is a recurring College requirement, not a public drop-in activity.
cards.short_summary: Since 1978, every Hampden-Sydney student has had to meet this rhetoric milestone.
cards.evidence_claim: The College states that all students, regardless of major, must pass the Rhetoric Proficiency Examination.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students; consult the academic calendar and Rhetoric Program for eligibility and scheduling.

cards.title: Mark “The Game” Against Randolph-Macon
cards.subtitle: Annual Hampden-Sydney–Randolph-Macon football rivalry
cards.notes: Follow the Tigers' announced schedule for the Randolph-Macon matchup. Attend only with a valid event ticket or watch through the College's listed broadcast options.
cards.short_summary: The annual archrival football contest is formally known as “The Game.”
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney Athletics identifies the 2026 contest with Randolph-Macon as the 131st edition of “The Game.”
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for November 14, 2026, at Fulton Field at Lewis C. Everett Stadium; ticketing details should be checked closer to the event.

cards.title: Line Up at the Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Senior commencement ritual
cards.notes: For graduating seniors, arrive in regalia at the Bell Tower at the announced lineup time. Families can watch the later commencement ceremony from designated areas.
cards.short_summary: The Bell Tower anchors the senior lineup immediately before the College's commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's 2026 commencement schedule directs seniors to line up in full regalia at the Bell Tower before commencement.
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors and their guests during commencement; follow the current year's posted instructions.
